items.t: Twin-turbo V8 burns oil and smokes on startup
items.job: Replace valve stem seals (engine stays in car)
items.note: Enginepatrol cites about $2,500 at independent shops and around $5,000 at a dealer. A worn-out engine may need a rebuild or replacement instead.

items.t: Worn valve stem seals make the V8 burn oil
items.job: Replace valve stem seals
items.note: Enginepatrol cites about $2,500 at independent shops and about $5,000 at a dealer.

items.t: Plastic cooling parts crack and the engine overheats
items.job: Replace radiator, expansion tank, water pump and thermostat
items.note: The E38 guide suggests budgeting $1,000-3,000 for overdue cooling work on a newly bought car.

items.t: Coolant leaks from the engine valley on the V8
items.job: Replace coolant transfer pipe and valley pan gasket
items.note: One owner quote in Enginepatrol's report was about $4,460 for the transfer pipe, valley pan gasket and water pump together.

items.t: Coolant leaks and overheating on the twin-turbo V8
items.job: Replace leaking coolant hoses, expansion tank and thermostat
items.note: Leaks under the turbos or in the engine valley cost more because of the labor to reach them.

items.t: Air suspension sags or the car sits low
items.job: Replace one air spring or strut
items.note: Enginepatrol cites over $2,000 for an OEM air strut and about $1,000 for an OEM compressor; RepairPal lists the 750Li compressor job at about $4,400-4,500.

items.t: Valve cover and oil filter housing gaskets leak oil
items.job: Replace valve cover or oil filter housing gaskets
items.note: Enginepatrol cites up to $2,000 at a dealer for the V8 alternator bracket gasket, or $500-1,000 at an independent shop.

items.t: Automatic transmission shifts harshly or slips
items.job: Replace mechatronic sleeve, filter pan and fluid
items.note: Enginepatrol cites about $4,000 for a mechatronic unit replacement; a full rebuild costs several thousand dollars.

items.t: Timing chain guides break on the V8
items.job: Replace timing chain guides and tensioner
items.note: A big job: valve covers, upper timing covers and VANOS units come off.

items.t: VANOS valve timing seals wear and power drops
items.job: Reseal or rebuild VANOS units
items.note: Rebuild kits and exchange units are widely available.

items.t: Valve cover leak floods spark plug wells and causes misfires
items.job: Replace valve cover gaskets and damaged ignition coils

items.t: Crankcase vent valve fails and the engine idles rough
items.job: Replace crankcase vent valve and hoses

items.t: V12 cooling system leaks and overheats
items.job: Replace leaking V12 cooling hoses and thermostats
items.note: Labor on the 750iL is much higher than on the V8 cars.

items.t: Front thrust arm bushings wear and the wheel shimmies when braking
items.job: Replace front thrust arms with bushings (pair)

items.t: ABS and traction control module fails when hot
items.job: Repair or replace ABS/DSC control unit
items.note: Rebuilding the original unit is usually cheaper than a new one.

items.t: Fuel injectors fail on the V12
items.job: Replace V12 fuel injectors (set of 6, one bank)
items.note: Cost doubles if both banks are done.

items.t: Car Access System fault stops the car from starting
items.job: Replace and program Car Access System module
items.note: Programming adds to the cost; diagnosis takes time.

items.t: Soft-close doors can look shut but open while driving (recall)
items.job: Dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at a BMW dealer under the recall. Outside the recall, a door latch repair is costly; ask for a written quote.

items.t: Car can roll away if left in Neutral instead of Park (recall)
items.job: Dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at a BMW dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Brake vacuum pump valve can leak oil and weaken the brakes (recall)
items.job: Dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at a BMW dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Ignition coils and spark plugs cause misfires on the V12
items.job: Replace spark plugs and failed ignition coils

items.t: Turbo cooling pump circuit board can overheat (recall)
items.job: Dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at a BMW dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Fuel injectors or high-pressure pump fail and the engine misfires
items.job: Replace high-pressure fuel pump or injectors
items.note: Enginepatrol cites about $200-300 per injector, and often all of them are replaced.

items.t: Plastic turbo charge pipe cracks and power drops
items.job: Replace turbo charge pipe

items.t: Airbag control module can reset (recall)
items.job: Dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at a BMW dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Active grille shutters stick and turn on the check engine light
items.job: Replace active grille shutter actuator
items.note: Enginepatrol cites about $100 for an actuator and $200-300 for the shutter assembly. BMW extended coverage to 15 years/150,000 miles.

items.t: Thermostat housing cracks and leaks coolant
items.job: Replace thermostat housing and thermostat

items.t: V12 valve cover and injector seals leak
items.job: Replace V12 valve cover gaskets and injector seals

items.t: Plug-in hybrid battery loses range or shows charging errors
items.job: Diagnose hybrid fault and update software
items.note: If the high-voltage battery needs replacing out of warranty, the cost is very high.

items.t: Integrated brake unit can lose power assist and ABS (recall)
items.job: Dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at a BMW dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Steering shaft joint can break (recall)
items.job: Dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at a BMW dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Hands-on steering wheel sensor can stop working (recall)
items.job: Dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at a BMW dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: A/C wiring can be damaged during a cabin filter change (recall)
items.job: Dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at a BMW dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: i7 high-voltage system can shut down and lose drive power (recall)
items.job: Dealer recall repair
items.note: Free under recalls 25V-395 (software) and 25V-470 (battery modules).

items.t: 750e driveshaft connection can fail (recall)
items.job: Dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at a BMW dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.
